leads.entry_rule: Consolidate daily prices to monthly bars; compute normalized trend signal s_n(t) = (p(t-1) - EMA_n(p, t-1)) / sigma_n(t-1), where sigma_n is the n-month EMA of absolute monthly price changes. Go long when s_n > 0 and short when s_n < 0 with contract quantity inversely proportional to sigma_n(t-1).
leads.exit_rule: Monthly rebalance on each new consolidated monthly bar: flip direction when sign(s_n) reverses and rescale position inversely to updated sigma_n.
leads.rule_description: QuantConnect implementation of Lemperiere, Deremble, Seager, Potters & Bouchaud (2014) 'Two Centuries of Trend Following' (applicable across FTMO energy, metals, FX, and indices): trades sign of (p - EMA_n(p)) / sigma_n with inverse-volatility sizing on monthly consolidated bars. Non-breakout, zero grid, zero martingale; hard per-trade stop-loss and take-profit are NOT_DISCLOSED.

leads.name: Intraday Equity Index Momentum (First 30-Min Return Predicts Last 30-Min)
leads.economic_rationale: Pre-market news digestion concentrates informed order flow in the first 30 minutes of trading, while late-informed investors and overnight-risk hedgers trade in the same direction during the final 30 minutes (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2017; Bogousslavsky 2016).
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Delayed institutional execution and end-of-day rebalancing flows echo the direction of opening-bell information absorption.
leads.entry_rule: Using M1 bars on US equity indexes (SPY/QQQ/DIA mapped to FTMO US500/US100/US30), compute the morning return over the first 30 minutes of the cash session (from prior close / opening window); at 30 minutes before market close (15:30 ET), go long if morning return > 0 or go short if morning return < 0.
leads.exit_rule: Flatten all positions strictly at the regular cash market close (30-minute holding window, zero overnight swap).
leads.rule_description: QuantConnect intraday index momentum strategy (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2017) on M1 bars for US equity indexes (US500, US100, US30): observe the return sign during the first 30 minutes of the cash session and enter in that direction for the final 30 minutes, exiting flat at market close (intraday swap=0). Non-breakout, zero grid, zero martingale; protective hard stop-loss and take-profit are NOT_DISCLOSED.

leads.name: VIX 2-Year Percentile Regime Timing for Equity Index (Vol Compression vs Spike)
leads.economic_rationale: Extreme implied volatility regimes are mean-reverting contrarian indicators for broad equity indexes: panic VIX spikes (>90th 2-year percentile) mark elevated forward risk-premia, whereas extreme VIX complacency (<10th percentile) precedes fragile index pullbacks.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Forced institutional put-buying during volatility panics depresses index valuations below fundamentals, while extreme vol compression induces crowded leverage buildup.
leads.entry_rule: Maintain a rolling 2-year (504 trading day) window of daily VIX closes split into 20 equally spaced percentiles (5%..95%). Go long equity index (S&P 100/500 mapped to US500) when daily VIX > 90th percentile (highest 2 boxes); go short equity index when daily VIX < 10th percentile (lowest 2 boxes).
leads.exit_rule: Hold active regime directional exposure until VIX crosses into the opposite extreme decile threshold (90th vs 10th percentile).
leads.rule_description: QuantConnect VIX percentile volatility-regime timing strategy on daily equity index (US500): rank daily VIX against a rolling 504-day 20-percentile ladder, going long index above the 90th VIX percentile (vol expansion fear) and short index below the 10th VIX percentile (vol compression complacency). Non-breakout, zero grid, zero martingale; hard stop-loss and take-profit levels are NOT_DISCLOSED.

leads.name: Optimal Stopping Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Pairs Trading (MLE Spread Thresholds)
leads.economic_rationale: Modeling a cointegrated spread portfolio as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) mean-reverting process allows analytical optimal entry and liquidation thresholds net of transaction costs (Leung & Li 2015, suggesting cointegrated pairs including gold-related pairs).
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Transient idiosyncratic liquidity shocks pull economically linked assets (e.g., gold/silver, WTI/Brent, commodity-bloc FX) apart before shared fundamentals pull the spread back toward equilibrium theta.
leads.entry_rule: Over a rolling 252-day window (retrained quarterly), grid-search hedge ratio beta in [0.01..1.00] to maximize the OU log-likelihood for portfolio value ($1 A - $beta B), extracting (theta*, mu*, sigma*). Solve the Leung-Li integral equations for optimal entry threshold b* and liquidation threshold d*; enter long A / short beta* B when spread portfolio value <= b*.
leads.exit_rule: Liquidate both legs of the spread portfolio when tracked portfolio value reaches the analytical optimal liquidation threshold d*; retrain OU parameters on the first day of each quarter.
leads.take_profit_rule: Analytical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck optimal liquidation level d* solved from Leung & Li equations with transaction cost c=0.05 and discount rate r=0.05
leads.rule_description: QuantConnect Leung & Li (2015) Ornstein-Uhlenbeck optimal-stopping pairs trading (generalized to FTMO cointegrated pairs XAUUSD/XAGUSD, USOIL/UKOIL, AUDUSD/NZDUSD): fits 252-day MLE OU parameters (beta*, theta*, mu*, sigma*) quarterly, enters when spread <= optimal entry level b*, and liquidates at optimal level d*. Non-breakout, zero grid, zero martingale; although Leung & Li (2015) discuss stop-loss exits in theory, the tutorial omits coding a hard SL (stop_loss_rule=NOT_DISCLOSED).

leads.name: International Country Equity Index Distance Pairs Trading (120D Formation)
leads.economic_rationale: Co-moving developed-market national equity indexes share common global macro drivers; short-term relative divergences between closely tracking country index pairs revert toward their 120-day normalized cumulative return relationship (Panagiotis, Dimitrios & Tao).
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Regional session flows and temporary local shocks create relative mispricings between globally integrated equity indexes that cross-border allocators arbitrage back.
leads.entry_rule: Over a 120-day formation period, compute normalized cumulative return indices for international equity indexes and rank all pairs by mean absolute distance D^(a,b); select the closest pairs for the subsequent 20-day trading month. When |index_A - index_B| > 0.5 * D^(a,b), short the higher index and buy the lower index dollar-neutral.
leads.exit_rule: Liquidate the pair when (index_A - index_B) reverts inside (-0.5*D^(a,b), +0.5*D^(a,b)), or roll and re-select top pairs at the start of the next month.
leads.take_profit_rule: Spread convergence when normalized cumulative index difference returns inside (-0.5 * D^(a,b), +0.5 * D^(a,b))
leads.rule_description: QuantConnect international equity-index distance pairs trading (applicable to FTMO developed indices US500, US30, GER40, UK100, JP225): 120-day formation selects lowest-distance pairs; during the 20-day trading window, short outperformer and buy underperformer dollar-neutral when spread exceeds 0.5x formation distance D, exiting when spread returns inside +/-0.5*D. Non-breakout, zero grid, zero martingale; protective hard stop-loss is NOT_DISCLOSED.
